query:
SELECT id FROM device
        WHERE
            CASE
                -- Only a number that fits int4 is an id; anything else is a
                -- serial, so an out of range number is a 404, not a cast error.
                WHEN $1 ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' OR ($1 ~ '^[0-9]{10}$' AND $1 <= '2147483647') THEN
                    id = $1::int4
                ELSE
                    serial_number = $1
            END
